#### B1 — `ansible-galaxy install` git clone injection (CVE-2026-11332)

**Changelog fragment:** [`changelogs/fragments/fix-cloning-malformed-role-requirements.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible/-/blob/changelogs/fragments/fix-cloning-malformed-role-requirements.yml)

**Affected definition (search-based inference):** `lib/ansible/galaxy/role.py` — the function that constructs the `git clone` call for role installation. The fix involves passing role requirements as positional arguments rather than interpolating them into the command string.

**References / callers:** `ansible-galaxy install` CLI path → `lib/ansible/galaxy/api.py` → `lib/ansible/galaxy/role.py`.

**Tests/docs:** No test fragment was added within the visible diff pages; a security advisory is noted in the changelog fragment itself.

**References / callers:** Callbacks that inspect `invocation` (e.g. the default callback `lib/ansible/plugins/callback/default.py`) are stated to already mask it; their behavior is unchanged.

**Public API impact:** `task_result['invocation']` is removed from the default public surface of registered variables — a **breaking change** for playbooks that read `register.invocation`.

### Cluster B — Security fixes (`CVE-2026-11332`, `winrm`/`psrp` `no_log`)

#### B1 — `ansible-galaxy install` git clone injection (CVE-2026-11332)

**Changelog fragment:** [`changelogs/fragments/fix-cloning-malformed-role-requirements.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ansible-ansible/-/blob/changelogs/fragments/fix-cloning-malformed-role-requirements.yml)

**Stated semantics:** Role dependency fields were passed as part of the `git clone` command string in a way that allowed a malicious role author to inject arbitrary git configuration.

**Affected definition (search-based inference):** `lib/ansible/galaxy/role.py` — the function that constructs the `git clone` call for role installation. The fix involves passing role requirements as positional arguments rather than interpolating them into the command string.

**References / callers:** `ansible-galaxy install` CLI path → `lib/ansible/galaxy/api.py` → `lib/ansible/galaxy/role.py`.

**Tests/docs:** No test fragment was added within the visible diff pages; a security advisory is noted in the changelog fragment itself.

**Navigation method:** Search-based (changelog diff → inferred call chain).

**Unavailable metadata:** Exact line change in `role.py`, test coverage path, CVE advisory URL.
